introduction.en: Which Dexter character do your harmless hobby choices bring to mind? This independent fan edition uses six limited angles on a completely fictional paper-mystery club: observing details, asking plainly, keeping people included, playful mechanisms, checking a claim and coordinating the plan. Twenty-four original situations involve no violence, real evidence or episode trivia. All six complete public guides are available before you start. The comparison is not a clinical, moral, criminality or forensic-ability assessment, and it does not assign or excuse harmful fictional actions.
introduction.zh: 无害的兴趣选择让你想到《嗜血法医》的哪位人物？本独立同人版在完全虚构的纸上谜案社团里取六个有限角度：看细节、平实提问、让人参与、趣味机关、核主张和协调计划。24道原创情境不设暴力、真实证据，也不考剧情。开测前可读六份全文。比较不评临床、道德、犯罪或法医能力，既不把虚构伤害赋给你，也不为它免责。

instructions.en: Think about a voluntary paper-puzzle or club activity you would enjoy now. Choose one of four responses for each of 24 situations, even if none is a perfect fit. No answer is correct, morally better or more professionally skilled. A character absent from an item is not rejected. Finish every choice before counts appear; all highest ties receive complete guides.
instructions.zh: 想象现在愿参加的自愿纸上谜题或社团活动，24个情境，每题四选一，即使都不完全合适。没有正确、道德更高或专业更强的答案。当题没出现的人物不算被拒绝。全部选择完成才显示计数，所有最高并列都有完整说明。

prompt.en: A club’s harmless paper mystery begins with an envelope of invented props. What would you most enjoy first?
prompt.zh: 社团的无害纸上谜案从一封虚构道具信封开始，你最想先做什么？

label.en: Look closely at how the small details are arranged before suggesting a pattern.
label.zh: 先细看小细节怎样摆放，再提出可能的规律。

label.en: Ask plainly what the group needs to decide in this round.
label.zh: 直接问这一轮小组需要决定什么。

label.en: Make sure everyone has a comfortable way to join the first discussion.
label.zh: 让每个人都能舒服地加入第一次讨论。

label.en: Try the little prop mechanism and see what makes it amusing.
label.zh: 试试小道具机关，看看哪里有趣。

prompt.en: The rules for a fictional clue game sound vague. Which contribution appeals most?
prompt.zh: 虚构线索游戏的规则听起来含糊，你最喜欢作什么贡献？

label.en: Ask a direct question about the part we are supposed to do next.
label.zh: 直接问清接下来到底要做哪部分。

label.en: Help the group discuss it without making uncertainty feel embarrassing.
label.zh: 帮大家轻松讨论，不让不清楚变成尴尬。

label.en: Test a playful example so the unclear part is easier to picture.
label.zh: 试一个有趣例子，让含糊部分更好想象。

label.en: Point out the specific inconsistency that prevents the rule from working.
label.zh: 指出让规则行不通的那处具体不一致。

prompt.en: A newcomer joins a puzzle table after the first clue has been opened. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 第一个线索拆开后，新人来到解谜桌，你更愿意怎么做？

label.en: Give a friendly, short recap so they can join without feeling left behind.
label.zh: 友好地简短回顾，让对方容易加入。

label.en: Show the most entertaining little mechanism in the props.
label.zh: 展示道具里最有趣的小机关。

label.en: Check that the recap does not skip a contradiction we still need to discuss.
label.zh: 看看回顾有没有漏掉还需讨论的矛盾。

label.en: Clarify the remaining roles so the new person can choose where to contribute.
label.zh: 说清剩余分工，让新人选择怎样贡献。

prompt.en: A toy lock in a paper mystery has an unexpected extra feature. What would you most enjoy?
prompt.zh: 纸上谜案里的玩具锁多了一个意外功能，你最喜欢什么？

label.en: Experiment with the feature as a playful part of the game.
label.zh: 把功能当成游戏趣味的一部分试一试。

label.en: Ask whether the extra feature fits the instructions we were given.
label.zh: 问额外功能和给的说明是否一致。

label.en: Decide how the group can use its time without getting stuck on the extra.
label.zh: 安排怎样用时间，免得被额外部分卡住。

label.en: Observe the small changes the feature makes before drawing a conclusion.
label.zh: 先观察功能带来哪些小变化，再下结论。

prompt.en: Two clue cards in an invented story cannot both be correct as written. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 自编故事里的两张线索卡，按文字看不可能同时正确，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Name the contradiction clearly and ask which detail needs checking.
label.zh: 说清矛盾，问需核哪一处细节。

label.en: Agree on a short plan for resolving it and continuing the round.
label.zh: 约一个短计划，解决后继续这一轮。

label.en: Compare the wording and layout closely to see what differs.
label.zh: 细比措辞和版式，看看差在哪里。

label.en: Ask the organiser directly what the cards are intended to establish.
label.zh: 直接问组织者，这两张卡原本要确立什么。

prompt.en: Your group is preparing a completely fictional mystery-club afternoon. Which part appeals most?
prompt.zh: 小组在准备完全虚构的谜案社团下午活动，你最喜欢哪部分？

label.en: Clarify the scope, roles and point at which the preparation is finished.
label.zh: 说清范围、分工，以及准备到哪里算完成。

label.en: Check the small arrangement of props for a coherent pattern.
label.zh: 检查道具小细节是否形成一致规律。

label.en: Say directly what information the plan still needs.
label.zh: 直接说计划还缺什么信息。

label.en: Make sure the people helping still feel included in the process.
label.zh: 让一起帮忙的人仍有被包括在过程里的感觉。

prompt.en: An illustration in the game contains several tiny repeated marks. What would you most like to do?
prompt.zh: 游戏插图里有几处微小重复印记，你最想做什么？

label.en: Observe the repetition carefully and describe it before interpreting it.
label.zh: 仔细观察重复，先描述，再解释。

label.en: Ask what question noticing the marks is meant to help answer.
label.zh: 问注意这些印记，是为了回答哪个问题。

label.en: Compare observations with others in a way that keeps the discussion easy to join.
label.zh: 和别人比较发现，让讨论仍好加入。

label.en: Try a playful way to reproduce the marks and see what happens.
label.zh: 用趣味办法重现印记，看看会怎样。

prompt.en: The next step in a paper puzzle is unclear, but the group keeps circling around it. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 纸上谜题下一步不清楚，小组却一直绕着聊，你更愿意怎么做？

label.en: Ask the unanswered question in a plain sentence.
label.zh: 用一句平实的话把没回答的问题问出来。

label.en: Help someone finish explaining what they are finding confusing.
label.zh: 帮一个人把困惑完整说完。

label.en: Make a quick, amusing example of what the step might mean.
label.zh: 迅速做个有趣例子，展示步骤可能是什么意思。

label.en: Challenge the assumption that is making the discussion go in circles.
label.zh: 质疑让讨论打转的那个假设。

prompt.en: A friend’s idea for a fictional puzzle has been misunderstood. What contribution attracts you?
prompt.zh: 朋友给虚构谜题提的点子被误解了，什么贡献更吸引你？

label.en: Help them feel heard while the group works out what they meant.
label.zh: 小组弄清原意时，让对方感到自己被听到了。

label.en: Demonstrate the fun part of the idea with a harmless prop.
label.zh: 用无害小道具演示点子里有趣的部分。

label.en: Separate the actual idea from the assumption people are arguing against.
label.zh: 区分真正点子与大家正在反对的假设。

label.en: Set out a short discussion plan so the idea gets a fair amount of time.
label.zh: 安排短讨论流程，让点子有合适时间被讨论。

prompt.en: The group can add one optional trick to a puzzle box. What would you most enjoy?
prompt.zh: 小组可以给谜题盒加一个可选小机关，你最喜欢什么？

label.en: An entertaining mechanism people can discover and laugh about together.
label.zh: 一个大家能一起发现、觉得有趣的机关。

label.en: A feature whose behaviour can be checked against the stated rule.
label.zh: 一个行为能与写明规则核对的功能。

label.en: An extra that fits the time, supplies and roles we have agreed.
label.zh: 一个符合约好时间、用品与分工的额外部分。

label.en: A subtle visual pattern that rewards careful observation of the box.
label.zh: 一个细看盒子就能注意到的微妙视觉规律。

prompt.en: A proposed solution to the fictional mystery leaves one clue unexplained. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 虚构谜案的提议解法还解释不了一条线索，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Ask specifically how the unexplained clue fits before calling the solution complete.
label.zh: 宣布解完前，具体问那条未解释线索怎样成立。

label.en: Agree how much more time to give it and who will check the remaining detail.
label.zh: 约好再给多少时间、谁核剩余细节。

label.en: Look again at the clue’s small details without assuming the first reading was right.
label.zh: 不预设初次读法正确，再看线索细节。

label.en: State plainly which question still needs an answer.
label.zh: 平实说出还需回答的是哪个问题。

prompt.en: Several people want to help with a simple mystery-game leaflet. What would you most like to clarify?
prompt.zh: 几个人都想帮忙做一张简单谜案游戏传单，你最想先说清什么？

label.en: The agreed outcome, responsibilities and deadline.
label.zh: 约好的成果、责任与截止时间。

label.en: The small details that need to remain consistent across the leaflet.
label.zh: 传单各部分需保持一致的小细节。

label.en: The exact information a visitor needs from us.
label.zh: 访客到底需要我们提供什么信息。

label.en: How everyone can contribute without feeling pushed aside.
label.zh: 大家怎样都能贡献，不觉得被挤到一旁。

prompt.en: You are comparing two versions of an invented clue sheet. What sounds most satisfying?
prompt.zh: 比较两版自编线索页时，什么最让你满足？

label.en: Notice the small differences and record them before deciding which matter.
label.zh: 注意小差异，先记下，再决定哪些重要。

label.en: Say directly which difference changes the task for the reader.
label.zh: 直接说哪处差异改变了读者任务。

label.en: Discuss the versions in a way that keeps their authors comfortable contributing.
label.zh: 讨论时让两版作者都能舒服贡献。

label.en: Try each version as a playful prop and enjoy discovering how it behaves.
label.zh: 把两版都当趣味道具试，享受发现怎样运作。

prompt.en: A friend asks whether their puzzle introduction is clear enough. What would you prefer to offer?
prompt.zh: 朋友问谜题开场说明是否够清楚，你更愿意提供什么？

label.en: A plain account of what I understood and the one thing I still need to know.
label.zh: 平实说自己理解了什么，还有哪一点需知道。

label.en: A friendly response that helps them keep discussing the draft.
label.zh: 友好回应，让对方愿意继续聊草稿。

label.en: A quick example that brings out the playful part of the introduction.
label.zh: 迅速用例子带出开场有趣的部分。

label.en: A specific challenge to a claim that the draft has not yet supported.
label.zh: 具体质疑草稿里一项尚未支持的主张。

prompt.en: Two people at the puzzle table have begun talking past each other. What would you most like to do?
prompt.zh: 解谜桌边两个人开始各说各话，你最想做什么？

label.en: Help each person finish a short explanation and feel included.
label.zh: 让双方各说完一小段，也感觉被包括在内。

label.en: Use a harmless prop to demonstrate the difference in a lighter way.
label.zh: 用无害道具轻松演示两种说法差在哪里。

label.en: Ask which assumption they are actually disagreeing about.
label.zh: 问真正不同意的是哪一个假设。

label.en: Set a short order for comparing the ideas and choosing a next step.
label.zh: 约一个短顺序，比较想法再选下一步。

prompt.en: A paper mystery includes an amusing gadget that is not necessary for the answer. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 纸上谜案有个解题并不必需的有趣小机关，你最喜欢怎样处理？

label.en: Enjoy trying the gadget as its own playful extra.
label.zh: 把机关当独立趣味额外部分玩一玩。

label.en: Keep clear which part is optional and which claim the answer depends on.
label.zh: 分清哪部分可选、答案依赖哪项主张。

label.en: Give it a bounded amount of time so the main plan still works.
label.zh: 给它一段有范围的时间，让主计划仍能进行。

label.en: Observe how the mechanism changes the prop’s small details.
label.zh: 观察机关怎样改变道具的小细节。

prompt.en: The organiser says the fictional mystery is solved, but a rule has changed without explanation. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 组织者说虚构谜案解完了，却有一条规则没解释就变了，你更愿意做什么？

label.en: Ask what changed and whether the new rule is meant to apply to everyone.
label.zh: 问改了什么、新规则是否对每个人同样适用。

label.en: Agree how to update the group’s plan so we can move on consistently.
label.zh: 约好怎样更新共同计划，再一致地继续。

label.en: Compare the original and changed wording carefully.
label.zh: 仔细比较原文与改后措辞。

label.en: Say plainly what explanation I need before accepting the ending.
label.zh: 平实说接受结尾前，自己需要什么解释。

prompt.en: A mock-case club has more preparation ideas than time. What would you most enjoy contributing?
prompt.zh: 模拟谜案社团的准备点子比时间多，你最喜欢贡献什么？

label.en: Choose a workable scope and clarify who is doing which agreed part.
label.zh: 选能做的范围，说清谁负责哪一块约定部分。

label.en: Inspect the essential props for small inconsistencies.
label.zh: 检查必需道具里的小小不一致。

label.en: Ask the direct question that will settle the next practical choice.
label.zh: 直接问一个能确定下一项实际选择的问题。

label.en: Keep the conversation welcoming as the group simplifies the plan.
label.zh: 计划缩小时，仍让交谈好加入。

prompt.en: A harmless photo puzzle seems to depend on the arrangement of ordinary objects. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 无害照片谜题似乎取决于普通物件的摆放，你更愿意怎么做？

label.en: Describe the arrangement closely before naming a possible pattern.
label.zh: 先仔细描述摆放，再提出可能规律。

label.en: Ask what information the puzzle actually wants us to extract.
label.zh: 问谜题到底要我们提取什么信息。

label.en: Compare observations with a partner so it remains a shared activity.
label.zh: 和伙伴比较观察，让它仍是共同活动。

label.en: Recreate the arrangement with simple props to enjoy testing it.
label.zh: 用简单道具重摆，享受试验。

prompt.en: The group’s invented story has a missing detail everybody is avoiding naming. What would you most like to offer?
prompt.zh: 小组自编故事缺一个细节，却没人明说，你最想提供什么？

label.en: A direct question that makes the missing part discussable.
label.zh: 一个直接问题，让缺的部分可以被讨论。

label.en: A friendly opening that makes it easier for someone to admit uncertainty.
label.zh: 一个友好入口，让人容易承认不确定。

label.en: A playful example that shows what the missing detail might affect.
label.zh: 一个趣味例子，展示缺失细节可能影响什么。

label.en: A clear challenge to the unsupported assumption that is covering the gap.
label.zh: 清楚质疑掩住空缺、却未获支持的那个假设。

prompt.en: Your paper-mystery club is choosing how to give feedback on unfinished drafts. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 纸上谜案社团在选怎样反馈未完成草稿，你最喜欢什么？

label.en: A conversation where each author can explain what they are trying to do.
label.zh: 让每位作者都能解释自己想做什么的交谈。

label.en: A playful demonstration round that lets people see ideas in action.
label.zh: 一轮趣味演示，让点子动起来给人看。

label.en: A method that asks which claim or rule each comment is testing.
label.zh: 一种问清每条意见在检验哪项主张或规则的办法。

label.en: A clear sequence, time limit and agreed purpose for the feedback.
label.zh: 明确反馈顺序、时间上限与共同目的。

prompt.en: A simple puzzle prop can be made in a serious or a comic version. What would you most enjoy?
prompt.zh: 简单谜题道具有认真版、喜剧版两种做法，你最喜欢什么？

label.en: Try the comic mechanism if the group enjoys that sort of play.
label.zh: 小组喜欢这种玩法的话，试喜剧小机关。

label.en: Check that either version follows the same understood rules.
label.zh: 核一下两版是否遵循同一套明白规则。

label.en: Choose the version that fits the agreed resources and running order.
label.zh: 选符合约定资源与流程的版本。

label.en: Compare the visual details that distinguish the two versions.
label.zh: 比较两版不同的视觉细节。

prompt.en: Before the group publishes its completely fictional puzzle, what would you most like to check?
prompt.zh: 小组公开完全虚构的谜题前，你最想核对什么？

label.en: Whether the solution actually follows from the clues and rules we present.
label.zh: 解法是否真的来自呈现的线索与规则。

label.en: Whether the agreed checks, roles and release plan are complete.
label.zh: 约好的检查、分工与发布安排是否完成。

label.en: Whether small labels and details tell one consistent story.
label.zh: 小标签与细节是否讲同一个前后一致的故事。

label.en: Whether readers can tell plainly what they are being asked to do.
label.zh: 读者能否平实看懂需要做什么。

prompt.en: The mystery-club session is ending with one small task unfinished. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 谜案社团活动快结束，还有一项小事未做完，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Agree on a bounded next step and who is genuinely willing to take it.
label.zh: 约一个有范围的下一步，确认谁真愿意接。

label.en: Look closely at the remaining details so the next person can see what is unfinished.
label.zh: 细看剩余部分，让接手的人看清缺什么。

label.en: State directly what still needs doing and what can wait.
label.zh: 直接说还需做什么、哪些可以等。

label.en: Close with a friendly recap that recognises everyone’s contribution.
label.zh: 友好回顾收尾，让各人的贡献得到看见。

scoreReading.en: Complete all 24 questions. Each explicitly mapped choice adds one raw count to one of six characters, for 24 counts in total. Every character appears 16 times, four times in each option position. An absent character option is not rejected. All highest counts receive complete guides; all A gives four each and six full guides. Counts are not similarity percentages, moral scores, diagnoses, forensic skill or population ranks. A small gap has no validated psychological significance.
scoreReading.zh: 24题全部完成，每项按明确映射给六位人物之一加1次，共24次。每位出现16次，四个位置各4次；当题没出现不算被拒绝。最高计数全部得到完整说明；全A会各4次，六份全文一起显示。次数不是相似百分比、道德分、诊断、法医技能或人群排名，微小差距没有经验证的心理意义。

title.zh: 刻意收窄的德克斯特角度

paragraphs.en: Dexter Morgan is the title character of the original crime series, which depicts serious violence. This edition does not turn those actions into virtues or traits assigned to you.
